clue.text: Sailor with way-out speech finds the bird

annotationWithheld.why: Sailor with way-out speech finds the bird (7): JACK is the sailor, but no reading of 'with way-out speech' gives DAW; the clue looks misread or garbled as held
annotationWithheld.clue: Sailor with way-out speech finds the bird

clue.text: Consumed from a vessel first whilst joined side by side

indicators.note: first says the vessel's word is placed before the word for consumed

parts.note: a jug is a vessel for pouring liquid
consumed means ate, as of food

explanation.surface: Someone drinks straight from a jug while sitting beside a companion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first' puts JUG ahead of ATE. 'whilst' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: In botany and heraldry the term describes paired items set together, like leaflets or coin heads overlapping.

clue.text: Picture the sails of a ship

explanation.surface: A painting showing a ship under sail.
explanation.definitionFit: An oil painting is done on this cloth, so it names the picture; sails were also made of the same heavy fabric.

clue.text: Finally head off?

parts.note: read as an execution: to remove a person's head once and for all, rather than to intercept someone

explanation.surface: A last attempt to head someone off before they get away.
explanation.definitionFit: Beheading literally takes the head off, and finally so.

clue.text: Type of pool to go round

explanation.surface: A kind of swimming pool where you spin around.
explanation.definitionFit: A whirlpool is a pool of spinning water, and to spin rapidly is a verb sense of the same word.

clue.text: Please pay in full

explanation.surface: A polite request to settle the bill completely.
explanation.definitionFit: To content someone is to please them, and to settle a debt or claim completely is another sense.

clue.text: Proud Len's extraordinary brilliance

indicators.note: extraordinary suggests something out of the usual order, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

parts.note: the possessive 's here gives a letter S, so Len's supplies LENS

explanation.surface: A man called Len is proud of his remarkable brilliance.
explanation.definitionFit: Magnificence or great brightness is the sense shared by both words.

clue.text: Move first to an African country

indicators.note: first says the word for move should be preceded by the word to, read in this order

parts.note: to move is to go

explanation.surface: An instruction to relocate first to somewhere in Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Move first' reads as one instruction, but 'first' governs the order of the two pieces, not a movement.
explanation.definitionFit: Togo is a West African nation between Ghana and Benin.

clue.text: Beer mugs have been broken in sink

indicators.note: broken items are smashed apart, so the letters of these two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Beer mugs have been smashed in the kitchen sink.
explanation.definitionFit: To sink something is to plunge it under water.

clue.text: Giving up or giving way

explanation.surface: Surrendering or yielding to someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Surrendering is yielding, and soft material that bends under pressure is also called yielding.

clue.text: Information one has about the body chemistry

definitions.note: the definition is a noun phrase while the answer is an adjective relating to genes

parts.note: gen is British slang for information
one as the Roman numeral I
C is short for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: Someone holds facts on how the body works chemically.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective concerns genes, the hereditary units governing a body's biochemistry.

clue.text: Consisting of badly formed characters?

parts.note: read as describing handwriting with poorly shaped letters, not people of bad character

explanation.surface: Something seems to be made up of people with flawed personalities.
explanation.definitionFit: Writing with badly shaped letters cannot be read.

clue.text: More pliant sort of jumpy surface?

indicators.note: sort here suggests sorting the letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A bouncier kind of springy surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A gymnastic frame of stretched fabric that people bounce on.

clue.text: Act deleted without hindrance

indicators.note: without means the word for hindrance is taken out of the clue word deleted

parts.note: a let is a hindrance, as in 'without let or hindrance' and a let in tennis

explanation.surface: A piece of legislation struck out without any obstacle.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing LET from DELETED leaves DE + ED. 'without let or hindrance' is a legal phrase, which helps the solver.
explanation.definitionFit: A deed is an act or feat performed.

clue.text: Lover undid the sweater

indicators.note: undoing knitting unpicks it, so the letters of these two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone's lover unravelled the knitted jumper.
explanation.definitionFit: A sweetheart is a beloved partner.

clue.text: Rail-car?

parts.note: read not as a railway carriage but as a car named after a railway stop, a vehicle with a rear loading door

explanation.surface: A carriage that runs on rails.
explanation.walkthrough: A station wagon (an estate car in Britain) is a car, and 'station' gives the rail link.
explanation.definitionFit: An estate car with a long body and rear door, its name tied to railway depots.

clue.text: So the soldier gets a word of warning

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, stands for soldiers in crosswords
fore is the golfer's shouted warning

explanation.surface: A soldier is given a warning, so to speak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gets' is a link. A golfer shouts FORE to warn others of an incoming ball.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words introduce a consequence: 'and so' means 'consequently'.

clue.text: Songster's dark headgear

definitions.note: the 's is read as 'is', linking definition to wordplay

parts.note: dark means black
a cap is headgear

explanation.surface: A singer's black hat.
explanation.walkthrough: A blackcap is a European warbler with a dark crown, so 'Songster' means a songbird.
explanation.definitionFit: A warbler is a songbird, and the male has a black crown.

clue.text: Relating to land in Indian city before rain-storm

indicators.note: before puts the city's name ahead of the rearranged letters

parts.note: Agra is the Indian city of the Taj Mahal

indicators.note: storm suggests turmoil, so the letters of rain are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: In an Indian city, something happens before a downpour.
explanation.definitionFit: Agrarian means concerning farmland and its cultivation.

clue.text: Cheerful but inconsiderate

explanation.surface: Someone happy but thoughtless.
explanation.definitionFit: Light-hearted means carefree and happy; it can also mean flippant, not taking things seriously enough.

clue.text: Boiler?

parts.note: not a central heating unit but a household appliance that heats water for tea

explanation.surface: A heating appliance in the home.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen appliance that heats water to boiling point.

clue.text: Main sort of diet

explanation.surface: The chief kind of diet.
explanation.definitionFit: A staple is the chief or principal item; a staple diet is one's regular basic food.

clue.text: Helmsman keeps a pet

indicators.note: keeps means holds inside, so one word sits within the other

parts.note: a cox steers a rowing boat

explanation.surface: A boat's steersman owns a pet animal.
explanation.definitionFit: To pet in the sense of fondle and persuade gently, wheedle.

clue.text: Unconcern of a group of soldiers

explanation.surface: Indifference shown by a military unit.
explanation.definitionFit: Aloofness and indifference is one sense; a squad detailed for a special duty is the military one.

clue.text: Animal goes round by the gorge

indicators.note: goes round means encircles, so the other word is put inside

parts.note: an ass is a donkey

explanation.surface: A creature walks around beside the ravine.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep chasm or ravine.

clue.text: Consequently left with nothing from the game

parts.note: so means consequently
O stands for nothing, or zero

explanation.surface: As a result, someone was left with nothing from playing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' is a link. Solo is the card game solo whist.
explanation.definitionFit: Solo whist is a card game in which one player plays alone against the rest.

clue.text: Footwork

parts.note: not the nimble movement of a boxer or dancer but the professional care of feet

explanation.surface: Nimble movement of the feet.
explanation.definitionFit: The medical treatment of feet, work done on feet.

clue.text: One caught rebelling will misbehave

definitions.note: the definition carries 'will' but the verb means the same as misbehave

parts.note: one is A, the indefinite article
ct is a cricket scorecard abbreviation for caught
up means in revolt, as in 'the people are up'

explanation.surface: A rebel who is caught will behave badly.
explanation.definitionFit: To act up is to behave badly, a phrasal verb.

clue.text: There is not much of an opening for this sort of camera

definitions.text: There is not much of an opening for this sort of camera

parts.words: There is not much of an opening for this sort of camera
parts.note: read as a career with few prospects; in fact it is a camera whose aperture is tiny

explanation.surface: Job prospects are poor for a certain kind of photographic equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: A simple camera uses a minute aperture in place of a lens.

clue.text: Expression of defiance by drunkard at this point in

parts.note: a sot is a habitual drinker
here means at this point

explanation.surface: A drunk shouts defiantly at this spot.
explanation.definitionFit: A taunt or retort of triumph, like 'take that'.
